text:
maya_marketing: Quick sync — Zephyr Labs vignette. Need to lock interview time, agree on 2x soundbites, and confirm legal release by EOD Wed. Can we also confirm webinar tease copy for launch day?

tom_prod: I can do product Q&A on Thurs 11am PT. prefer async notes first though.

sarah_marketing: Uploaded the one-pager to the drive: https://rwd.docs/zephyr-vignette v0.3. Hero metric + 3 headline soundbites at top. Asking for short customer quote (<= 140 chars).

ben_legal: Heads up — any comparative claim needs customer signoff and a lightweight quote release. Draft language in doc under /legal-snippets. We should ask for a signed checkbox in the thumbs-up email.

jessica_cs: Jordan (Zephyr) prefers Thu morning or Fri 9am PT. Wants to review final transcript and pick the quote to publish. Also flagged they can't do any benchmark numbers without approval from their data team.

noah_sales: Please cc sales@ on the final publish so inbound leads get tagged. Sales wants the short CTA and a one-slide product takeaway for demos.

maya_marketing: Noted. Plan: lock Thurs 11am PT interview w/ Tom + Maya. Sarah to send prep deck + three suggested Qs. Ben, can you drop the release checkbox snippet by EOD? Noah, we'll include demo slide and CTA in the asset pack.

ben_legal: Will add release snippet and a one-sentence legal header. Example to propose: `By approving this quote, Zephyr Labs grants Redwood Inference permission to use the quote in marketing materials and confirms factual accuracy.`

sarah_marketing: Draft teaser copy for launch post: "How Zephyr scaled inference throughput 3x with Redwood — a customer vignette. Webinar May 12 — register." Want feedback on tone (straightforward vs. narrative).

maya_marketing: Lean narrative. Short headline, then 2 bullets with numbers, then CTA. Sarah, can you A/B the copy in the golden doc?

noah_sales: Routing note — once published route form responses to sales@ with tag `zephyr-launch` and create a Salesforce task for follow-up within 48h. opsbot, can you set that automation?

opsbot: @channel Automation created: form -> sales@ -> SF task (48h) tag=`zephyr-launch`. Test email sent to noah_sales.

jessica_cs: Confirmed with Jordan: they're fine with narrative tone, will pick quote post-transcript. Also asked that any performance claims include a link to our benchmark appendix.

maya_marketing: Great. Action list: 1) Sarah send prep + A/B copy. 2) Tom + Jordan interview Thurs 11am PT (record). 3) Ben provide release snippet. 4) Noah verify sales automation. 5) Publish assets + demo slide, route leads. Back here after interview with quote candidates. :thumbsup:
